about.en: Nasdaq xStock (QQQx) is a tokenized tracker certificate on Invesco QQQ Trust, the ETF tracking the Nasdaq-100, issued by Backed under the xStocks brand. Each token is backed 1:1 by QQQ shares held with qualified custodians and tracks the ETF price on-chain on Solana (Xs8S1uUs1zvS2p7iwtsG3b6fkhpvmwz4GYU3gWAmWHZ), Ethereum, BNB Chain, Arbitrum and other networks. xStocks are offered to non-US investors.
